rfm_tuples.M_value: Two sections of the same 10-K cite '40%' for two different denominators - the Customers section (40% = 10 largest customers) and the Note (40% to Deere alone in 2023 implausible vs 13% same year). summary: Titan International is honestly disclosing a deep ag/construction-equipment cyclical slowdown while simultaneously levering up to acquire Carlstar at the cycle's top. Organic Q1 2024 revenue was -22% YoY ex-Carlstar; net debt jumped 78%. Disclosures verify (auditor clean, no going-concern, covenants compliant, bond at 98% of par). Mode-B gaps: (1) Carlstar-stub revenue masking organic collapse in headline framing, (2) Russian subsidiary still consolidated with zero quantification, (3) large residual goodwill on a cyclical consumer-discretionary acquisition. Insiders are aligned (no selling, CEO took fresh 80K-share grant). Per honesty-alpha framework: TWI is NOT lying - they are an honest cyclical credit with above-average disclosure quality. Distress flags exist but are operating, not control-environment. Verdict: NEUTRAL with mild SHORT lean from acquisition-timing and Russia-disclosure gaps.
